verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an operating system, but the evidence pack documents no Windows feature for exporting a user's data in open formats. Backing up a BitLocker recovery key is an adjacent security control, not a data export. Community accounts of users switching to Linux describe their own migrations, not a Windows capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
